topic: Reviewing campaign status and link sharing
summary_markdown:
The team reviewed the client's campaign manager and gained a better understanding of its functionality. A follow-up discussion on campaign statuses is proposed for the next day.

Regarding link sharing, it was noted that the feature does not need to be built; rather, it requires fixing because it currently malfunctions (freezing). It was also mentioned that the signup and single-use functionality for such links are understood, but if they are not critical, development effort should be avoided.
decisions: No concrete decisions were made regarding link sharing implementation.
action_items: Schedule a follow-up discussion on campaign statuses for the next day.
